name: Marvin Inu
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: According to official news, Marvin Inu’s cross-chain bridge was hacked, and tokens worth 110 ETH were stolen and sold, causing a sharp drop in price. The project party has closed the cross-chain bridge and fixed the loopholes. At the same time, it has adjusted the purchase tax to 0%, and promised to repurchase and destroy the tokens to make up for this loss after the price fluctuations stabilize.
